mapper.select: SELECT m.product_id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name, m.spec AS spec, COALESCE(SUM(m.quantity), 0) AS quantity, MAX(m.unit_value) AS unit_value FROM zc_sales_order_material m INNER JOIN zc_sales_order o ON m.order_id = o.id AND o.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN zc_product p ON m.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.product_id IS NOT NULL AND o.confirm_time IS NOT NULL AND o.confirm_time BETWEEN #{reqVO.confirmTime[0]} AND #{reqVO.confirmTime[1]} GROUP BY m.product_id, p.name, m.spec ORDER BY m.product_id ASC, m.spec ASC
